nodes.title: Weeks 1-2: Personal and Social Well-being — My Body and Growth
nodes.description: Personal and Social Well-being: Physical growth and development, puberty awareness, personal hygiene and health. Creative Arts: Visual art — exploring line, shape and colour. Physical Education: Introductory movement activities, body awareness.

nodes.title: Weeks 3-4: Beginning Knowledge — Living and Non-living Things
nodes.description: Beginning Knowledge (Natural Sciences): Differences between living and non-living things; characteristics of living organisms. Technology: Structures and materials in the environment. Creative Arts: Performing arts — drama and movement.

nodes.title: Weeks 5-6: Personal and Social Well-being — Relationships and Values
nodes.description: Personal and Social Well-being: Building positive relationships; communicating feelings appropriately; understanding values such as respect, honesty and responsibility. Creative Arts: Music — singing, rhythm and beat.

nodes.title: Weeks 7-8: Beginning Knowledge — Matter and Materials
nodes.description: Beginning Knowledge (Natural Sciences and Technology): Properties of materials; sorting and grouping materials; processing materials. Physical Education: Ball skills and cooperative games.

nodes.title: Weeks 9-10: Creative Arts and Physical Education Assessment
nodes.description: Creative Arts: Integrated arts project — visual art and performing arts. Physical Education: Formal skills assessment. Personal and Social Well-being: Consolidation of term topics.

nodes.title: Weeks 1-2: Beginning Knowledge — Energy and Change
nodes.description: Beginning Knowledge (Natural Sciences): Forms of energy — light, heat, sound and movement. How energy is used in everyday life. Creative Arts: Visual art — colour mixing and texture.

nodes.title: Weeks 3-4: Personal and Social Well-being — Safety and Healthy Living
nodes.description: Personal and Social Well-being: Road safety, water safety and fire safety rules; healthy food choices and balanced diet; importance of exercise and rest. Physical Education: Athletics — running, jumping and throwing skills.

nodes.title: Weeks 5-6: Beginning Knowledge — Earth and Beyond
nodes.description: Beginning Knowledge (Natural Sciences): The solar system, planets and the moon; day and night; seasons. Creative Arts: Performing arts — dance sequences, creative movement.

nodes.title: Weeks 7-8: Creative Arts — Music and Drama
nodes.description: Creative Arts: Music — playing simple instruments, reading basic notation; Drama — creating and performing a short play. Personal and Social Well-being: Dealing with peer pressure and conflict resolution.

nodes.title: Weeks 9-10: Assessment and Consolidation
nodes.description: Formal Assessment: Creative Arts portfolio assessment. Physical Education: Practical skills test. Beginning Knowledge: Written assessment on energy, materials and earth and beyond. Personal and Social Well-being: consolidation.
